description: This file provides test support utilities for WebSocket interactions, including mock WebSocket task and session implementations, JSON message construction, and protocol extensions to facilitate unit testing of WebSocket communication in a Swift project.

classes.name: GatewayTestWebSocketTask
classes.description: A mock implementation of WebSocketTasking for testing WebSocket interactions, supporting message send/receive, state management, and hook configuration.

classes.name: GatewayTestWebSocketSession
classes.description: A mock WebSocket session that creates and manages GatewayTestWebSocketTask instances, enabling controlled WebSocket testing.

methods.name: connectChallengeData
methods.description: Generates a mock challenge data message in JSON format as Data.

methods.name: connectRequestID
methods.description: Extracts the request ID from a WebSocket message if it is a connection request.

methods.name: connectOkData
methods.description: Creates a mock successful connection response Data with a given ID.

methods.name: connectAuthFailureData
methods.description: Creates a mock authentication failure response Data with detailed error info.

methods.name: requestID
methods.description: Extracts the request ID from a WebSocket message.

methods.name: okResponseData
methods.description: Creates a mock positive response message Data with a specific ID.
